backup.full_fresh_dump_restore: NOT RUN; prior full restore Phase 4 PASS

archive_replay.mode: scoped source-history replay; not full-dump restore
archive_replay.rollback: flags OFF; additive schema retained; post-migration employee/period preserved

concurrency.engine: PostgreSQL 17.6 on x86_64-windows, compiled by msvc-19.44.35213, 64-bit
checks: real PostgreSQL release migration defaults OFF and rejects lifecycle/reuse without confirmations
two real sessions serialize create and allocate distinct smallest numbers/principals
in-flight work-log INSERT cannot open a shift after termination commits
concurrent rehire versus create cannot claim the same HR number
termination waits for concurrent open shift and then refuses to archive
termination waits for concurrent draft payroll and refuses to archive
concurrent SACS claim versus rehire cannot send a delayed inactive write after rehire
concurrent release shutdown uses consistent lock order and prevents a waiting lifecycle operation
feature shutdown waits for the in-flight feature row lock, then denies subsequent requests
waiting admission rechecks enabled after concurrent OFF commit and fails closed
